limitations: Named referent gold covers a small subset of all sentences and excludes unnamed pronouns, anaphoric equality resolution, names assigned to multiple entities, event referent unification, and all cross-document identity.
Sense-labeled concepts can include event/type noun rather than only action, and role mapping can require semantic generalization; this is a diagnostic subset, NOT whole truth conditions.
A NAME clause outside a negated box does not imply that the named entity is being negated; only relation to the scoped lexical event is scored.
PMB short sentences are not new scientific documents, dream-law contexts or verification of truth. Model output is a published real automatic parse, not KMD production.
